name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Gutted Civil Rights Agency, Stifling U.S. Scrutiny of Workplace Bias
changes.summary: A little-known federal office spent decades investigating potential discrimination by government contractors — until it was stopped by the Trump administration.

changes.title: Trump Blasts ‘Sanctuary’ States, but Many Still Aid Deportations
changes.summary: A New York Times review of 18 states targeted by the Trump administration for their “sanctuary” policies found that all cooperate significantly with immigration authorities in cases involving violent crimes.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Trump's speech; midterm elections; Todd Blanche and Jay Clayton
changes.summary: Three months from the November midterms, President Trump is drawing attention to issues that are not top priorities for voters.

changes.title: Air quality improving in Northeast, while wildfire smoke hangs over Midwest
changes.summary: Wildfire smoke and unhealthy air persist and shift direction, as Trump demands explanation from Canada. (Image credit: Finn Gomez/Getty Images).

changes.title: Mike Lindell Not Registered to Vote in Minnesota, Where He is Running for Governor
changes.summary: President Trump endorsed Mike Lindell, a leader of the election denial movement, for Minnesota governor this week.

changes.title: Russia Bill Broadens Sanctions but Could Fuel Fears Over the Dollar
changes.summary: The Trump administration has recently sought to scale back sanctions as adversaries develop workarounds that some believe could erode the U.S. dollar’s supremacy.

changes.title: As Trump Scraps With Meloni, His Envoy to Italy Is at Sea
changes.summary: Tilman J. Fertitta, the U.S. ambassador to Rome, is summering on his superyacht as President Trump squabbles with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni of Italy.

changes.title: Trump's Endorsement Could Set the Stage for a Historic Senate Succession
changes.summary: Sen. Darline Graham Nordone to run for a full term in November, in what could become a historic.

changes.title: What to know about Trump's claim that over 250K non-citizens are registered to vote
changes.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin sent letters to four states alleging that a combined 250,000 non-citizens were registered to vote. Elections experts caution that could be a significant overcount.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Defence minister seeks three ‘Nahal’ outposts in Gaza as top commander says Israel now controls 65% of the strip, violating Trump ceasefire deal Israel’s defence and finance ministers announced plans for three illegal settlements in Gaza and more than $400m (£300m) in funding to expand construction in the occupied West.
